title: Review sheet data file
description: The data file a review sheet page renders from, published as sheet.json beside the page. It holds the review's title, one card per call the owner has to make, and a block that depends on the sheet's kind. The rules this schema cannot express are: card ids are unique within the sheet; option ids are unique within their card; every id in remainder.unsettled names a card in the sheet; a recommendation's optionId, when present, names one of that card's option ids.

schema.description: The name and version of this data format, which is always superheroes-sheet/1.

kind.description: Which sheet this is: a remainder sheet for a review that left findings unsettled, a final sheet for a finished review, or a plain sheet with only cards.

title.description: The review's name, shown in the app bar.

remainder.description: The summary of a review that left findings unsettled, present only on a remainder sheet.

fixesMade.description: How many fixes the review made.

unsettled.description: The ids of the cards that hold a finding the review did not settle.

final.description: The summary of a finished review, present only on a final sheet.

history.description: What the review did, in counts and one line about the vet.

fixesMade.description: How many fixes the review made.

vet.description: The vet's outcome in one line.

declinedFindings.description: The findings the review chose not to act on, each with its reason.

items.description: One finding the review declined, with the reason it was declined.

approval.description: Whether the review ended with an approved board and where that board is kept.

approvedBoard.description: True when there is an approved board.

boardSavedWithSpec.description: True when the approved board is saved with the spec.

cards.description: The calls the owner has to make, one card each.

allOf.description: A remainder sheet must carry the remainder block and must not carry the final block.
A final sheet must carry the final block and must not carry the remainder block.
A plain sheet must carry neither the remainder block nor the final block.

id.description: A short lowercase identifier made of letters, digits and hyphens that starts with a letter or digit.

answer.description: The document a review sheet page stores for one card, in the sheet's own store. The collection is answers, with one document per card id at answers/<card id>, and each document is written whole on every change. The owner's last tap counts, and the answer is null only when a note was saved before any pick. This is not part of the data file: no property of the sheet refers to it, and the page reads its answer choices from it.
What the owner tapped: aligned, discuss, option for a pick of one of the card's options, or null when nothing was picked yet.

optionId.description: The id of the picked option, or null. It is a string exactly when the answer is option.

note.description: The owner's note on the card, an empty string when there is none.

allOf.description: An answer of option must name the picked option.
An answer other than option must not name an option.

card.description: One call the owner has to make, with the question, what is true now, and the options and recommendation if there are any.

id.description: The card's identifier, unique within the sheet and kept the same across republishes so saved answers still match.

callKind.description: The kind of call in plain words, shown on the card's badge.

warning.description: True for the red warning badge: a gap the reviewer found, a statement with no source, or a finding the review did not settle.

question.description: The question the owner is asked, in one line.

context.description: What the owner needs to know to answer: what is true now, why it needs them, and the exact underlying text if there is any.

whyOwner.description: Why this call needs the owner.

exactText.description: The exact text the call is about, or null when the call has no underlying text; the key itself is always present.

images.description: Pictures that help the owner answer, which may be empty.

options.description: The choices the owner can pick from, which may be empty when the call has no fixed choices.

image.description: One picture shown on a card.

src.description: Where the picture is, either a path published with the sheet or a URL.

alt.description: A plain-words description of the picture for people who cannot see it.

caption.description: A short line shown under the picture.

option.description: One choice the owner can pick on a card.

id.description: The option's identifier, unique within its card.

label.description: The option's name as the owner sees it.

consequence.description: The plain consequence of picking this option.

recommendation.description: What the review recommends for a card, which a card may leave out.

optionId.description: The id of the option this recommends, which must be one of the same card's option ids.
